spans.s:
śalá, m.
 —1. staff;
 —2. prickle (of a
hedge-hog). [cf. śará.]

śā́lā, f. hut; house; room; stable. [see
under śaraṇa: cf. the derivs καλιά and
Eng. hall, there given.]

śālin, a.
 —1. possessing a house;
 —2. at
end of cpds, attenuated in mg so as to signify
merely possessing…. [śālā.]

śālmalī, f. Salmalia malabarica, the silkcotton
tree.
